title: STACK OF SIGNALS (DATA, NOT NOISE)
style: Style note for Suno: INDUSTRIAL ELECTRONIC, club‑ready remix potential, 4-on-the-floor kick in hook, mechanical groove, spoken word verses, vocoder hooks, no trap hats.
lyrics:
[Intro – female vocoder, filtered, over slow build]
Stay grounded in data, not noise.
High-signal only.
On-chain truth for long-term minds.

[spoken ad‑lib, male]
Yeah… this one’s for the stack.

[Verse 1 – male, calm but driving]
From the cockpit to the chain, same discipline, new terrain,
Tom’s reading Bitcoin flow like instruments in rain.
Seven thousand serious minds in a quiet room,
Talking cycles, not hopium boom.
He built a high-signal space for the long-term crowd,
Where clarity and conviction talk louder than loud.
No surface-level takes, no ten‑second clips,
Just deep-cycle frameworks and risk on the lips.

Custom metrics on the screen, that’s the On-Chain rig,
Composite scores, cycle bands, macro signals big.
While the feed sells drama in a 10x voice,
He says “slow down, zoom out, data, not noise.”

[Pre‑Hook – robotic counter‑voice, call/response]
Question: bull or bear?
Answer: check the regime.
Question: what’s it worth?
Answer: model the stream.

[Hook – male lead + female vocoder, club energy]
Stack of signals, no random toys,
On-Chain Mind: data, not noise.
From deep drawdowns to cycle poise,
He maps the stress where the pain deploys.
If you’re done with hype and influencer ploys,
Tap into the stack that the pros enjoy.
Indicator suite, turn down the noise,
This is On-Chain Mind. Data, not noise.

[Verse 2 – male, slightly faster]
He’s not the “buy now, all in” type,
No fortune cookie lines, no thumbnail hype.
He gives you tools he wished he had at the start,
Clean visuals, risk bands, cycle maps of the heart.
Particle physics in his mental code,
Filtering out chaos in this crypto road.
He sees the chain like a system with state,
Where every cohort shows fear or faith.

Days under water, cohorts in pain,
He charts the teeth‑grit phase of the game.
Capitulation isn’t just one red bar,
It’s time plus pressure in a macro scar.
When composite risk compresses and breath runs tight,
That’s where patient money steps into the night.

[Short bilingual tag – female vocoder, soft]
No es drama, es estructura.
Não é hype, é leitura.

[Hook – repeat, bigger with extra layers]
Stack of signals, no random toys,
On-Chain Mind: data, not noise.
From deep drawdowns to cycle poise,
He maps the stress where the pain deploys.
If you’re done with hype and influencer ploys,
Tap into the stack that the pros enjoy.
Indicator suite, turn down the noise,
This is On-Chain Mind. Data, not noise.

[Bridge – spoken, breakdown for club mix]
Hundreds of custom metrics.
Cycle models.
Risk and macro signals.
Trend and momentum tools.
You don’t need prophecy,
you need a better lens.

When will the pain stop?
Not when the timeline says so.
When the chain
says the stress has changed.

[Verse 3 – male, future‑legend tone]
He’s got composites, Ω‑scores, halving frames,
Risk lights flipping as we move through games.
From boring chop to blow‑off nights,
He tags the zones where FOMO ignites.
But he won’t sell tops or bottoms as fate,
Just a probability band and a time‑based gate.

He’ll show you DCA vs lump-sum risk,
MSTR exposure when the market gets brisk.
Bull over? Bear done? How long will it last?
He answers with cycles, not a viral cast.
You still choose your size, your entry, your grind,
He just hands you the compass: On-Chain Mind.

[Final Hook – full anthemic, built for remixes]
Stack of signals, cut through the noise,
On-Chain Mind for the real convoy.
If you value truth over easy joys,
Plug into the data, tune out the noise.
From cockpit calm to the crypto void,
He built these tools so your edge deployed.
One mission only: guide serious minds,
To stay grounded in data,
not noise, On-Chain Mind.

[Outro – female vocoder + soft robot]
Onchainmind dot app.
Onchainmind dot io.
Clarity. Conviction.
On-chain analytics.
Data, not noise.
